name: Text Intelligence
description: Reference pre-filter processor: analyzes chat comments and viewer names with a local textintel engine before automation filters run.
longDescription:
Reference pre-filter processor: analyzes chat comments and viewer names with a local textintel engine before automation filters run.

- Annotations merge under `event.intel`; raw fields are never modified
- Failures fail open and pass the original event through

description.default: Analyze comments and viewer names before automation filters.

hint.default: True when TextIntel blocked this chat message (spam or bad words).

analyzeNicknames.description: Analyze viewer display names for TTS pronunciation.

analyzeUsernames.description: Also analyze stable handles (language/composition only, never spoken).

spam.description: Expose heuristic spam scores (filtering stays user-controlled).

filterSpam.description: Mark messages as blocked when the TextIntel spam score reaches the configured threshold.

spamThreshold.description: Spam score required to block a message when spam filtering is enabled.

filterBadWords.description: Block messages containing configured words or phrases after TextIntel normalization.

badWords.description: Words or phrases to block. Matching uses TextIntel normalized and anti-obfuscation views.

muteBlockedTts.description: Prevent blocked messages from being spoken by TTS.

ttsCandidate.description: Resolve spoken TTS candidates with confidence.

engineMode.description: Textintel engine preset (offline only). Lite is default: default mode is much slower on long input.

minimumTtsConfidence.description: Minimum spoken-candidate confidence before falling back to raw text.

minimumRebusConfidence.description: Minimum rebus score before exposing a candidate.

maxInputChars.description: Truncate analyzed text to this many characters.

emojiMode.description: Emoji policy for the spoken TTS text.
